SolidCraft

An open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust.
Sketch, constrain, and build solids with a parametric feature timeline. Change a dimension and watch your model rebuild. Run it on your desktop, in your browser, or let AI agents model through the built-in MCP server.

[![Download for Windows][badge-windows]][windows-msi] [![Download for macOS][badge-macos]][macos-dmg] [![Download for Linux][badge-linux]][linux-appimage] [![Get it from the Snap Store][badge-snap]][snap-store] [![Try it in your browser][badge-web]][web-app]

Website · Download · Try it in the browser · Documentation · Discord · SolidCore

![SolidCraft: model a Raspberry Pi 4 case from an empty design: a sketch dimensioned with parameters, extrude, fillets and shell, a rim rounded in one pick, standoffs patterned on the board's mounting holes, port cut-outs, vent slots, "Pi 4" engraved in a font, a PETG material with its mass in Properties, and a height change in Parameters](docs/screenshots/demo.gif) *A Raspberry Pi 4 case from an empty design: a sketch dimensioned with the board's parameters, extrude, fillet, shell, the rim rounded in one pick, an M2.5 standoff patterned on the 58 × 49 mm hole rectangle, port cut-outs, vent slots, "Pi 4" engraved in DejaVu Sans Bold and a PETG material defined in the design, with its mass in Properties, then height 24 → 32 mm in Parameters and it all rebuilds. 6× playback with the idle pauses cut. [Full video](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/raw/refs/heads/main/docs/screenshots/demo.mp4), recorded with the [demo script](examples/demo/record_ui.sh).* ## Download - **Windows:** the [installer][windows-msi]. - **macOS:** the [disk image][macos-dmg] (Apple silicon and Intel). - **Linux:** the [AppImage][linux-appimage], or `sudo snap install solidcraft` ([Snap Store][snap-store]). - **Web:** [try it in your browser][web-app], no install. ARM64 and 32-bit builds, portable zip, .deb, .rpm, Flatpak and the other packages are on the [downloads page](docs/downloads.md). The macOS app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. The Windows downloads aren't signed yet: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway** in SmartScreen. On SolidCraft 0.11 to 0.14, download once by hand; see [updating](https://docs.solidcraft.io/guide/updates.html#updating-from-011-to-014). ## What works Early but usable for simple parts: 75 of 76 public reference parts match their analytic or FreeCAD-computed volume, area, centre of mass and bounding box ([oracle](docs/oracle.md)); the other is a tracked bug. - **Sketches and constraints:** lines, arcs, splines, text and more, solved by our own constraint solver, with parameter-driven dimensions. - **Features:** extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, fillet, chamfer, shell, draft, holes, threads, patterns, mirror, split and combine on an editable parametric timeline. - **Parameters and configurations** with unit-aware expressions. - **Assemblies** with joints, motion studies, contact sets, interference and mass properties. - **Sheet metal** with flanges, hems, fold/unfold and flat patterns, and plastic enclosure features. - **Files:** STEP, IGES, 3MF, STL, OBJ and glTF in and out where supported, URDF export, `.sc` designs (`.solidcraft` files from earlier releases still open). - **Desktop app, browser app, headless CLI and MCP server**, all running the same commands. The full list is in [docs/capabilities.md](docs/capabilities.md) and [docs/features.md](docs/features.md); status and plans are in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md). See also [what people built](docs/showcase.md), [3D mouse support](docs/3d-mouse.md) and the [architecture](docs/architecture.md). ## Build from source ```sh cargo run --release -p solidcraft -- --sample # desktop app with a sample part cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- commands # the command registry cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- run examples/bracket.json --out bracket.step cargo xtask ci # fmt, clippy, tests, icons, assets, layers, wasm ``` More commands, the Windows cross-build and the browser build are in [docs/building.md](docs/building.md). ## AI agents (MCP) `solidcraft-cli mcp` is a [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server. Headless it runs its own design session, or with `--connect` it drives the running app so you can watch. Claude Code: `claude mcp add solidcraft -- solidcraft-cli mcp`. If a terminal doesn't find `solidcraft-cli` (older Windows installers don't put it on `PATH`), give its full path (by default `"C:\\Program Files\\SolidCraft\\solidcraft-cli.exe"`). Tools, access rules and an example session: [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md). ## Scripts A script is a JSON list of the same commands the UI runs, executed with `solidcraft-cli run`. Format and example: [docs/scripts.md](docs/scripts.md). Pages can also be driven through the [browser command API](docs/browser-api.md). ## Contributing Help is welcome. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) covers how to build and test, the code map, the clean-room and licence rules, and where help is wanted most. Open work is in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/issues); chat is on [Discord](https://discord.gg/FtU4NQNVDH). ## Sponsors [![CI powered by Blacksmith](docs/sponsors/blacksmith-ci-powered.png)](https://www.blacksmith.sh) SolidCraft's continuous integration runs on [Blacksmith](https://www.blacksmith.sh), which sponsors its CI minutes. ## Disclaimer The files in this repository are provided as is, without warranty, liability or indemnity, and Tangency Labs and the contributors accept no responsibility for any harmful or unlawful use of them: read [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md). ## Licence MIT OR Apache-2.0, at your option. Developed under the [clean-room contribution rules](AGENTS.md); third-party code and assets retain their documented licences and attribution. SolidCraft is independent. Behaviour is designed from public documentation, general CAD conventions and user feedback. Reference tests use analytic values and open-source tools.
